done.why: I had seen a good sample and stopped partway into a sword fight, without reaching an ending.

about: An underground cave world. I'm a returning hero on a final test, exploring caverns. A trickster up a cliff steals a chest I tied to his rope, and a hooded swordsman blocks my way.

moments.note: Someone unseen up the cliff reacted to what I did, which felt alive.
I tied the chest to the rope as the voice suggested. He took it and left me stuck, so I was tricked.
I didn't know whether waiting would do anything.
Going south put me in the dark with a grue warning, and I didn't know what to do.
The sword from the junction appeared in my hand without my taking it.

wished: Talk to the man at the top of the cliff properly, not only shout.
Know what the final test is and where to find the old man.

lines.line: That is uncommonly good of you, I do say! ... Oh, you are stuck, aren't you.
lines.why: The trickster's betrayal was a memorable moment.

lines.line: It is pitch black. You are likely to be eaten by a grue.
lines.why: It told me I needed light.

fun.why: The cliff trickster made the world feel responsive.

engagement.why: I wanted to keep exploring after the trick.

difficulty.why: Mostly clear, but I got tricked and didn't know what the parser accepts.

interestingness.why: The scenes had varied places and characters.

prose.why: The prose is evocative and reacts to my actions.
